ana: Quick heads-up: I'm adding a tiny "SELinux + cgroup" troubleshooting note to the Private installer docs. Goal: short systemd socket drop-in, manual chown/chmod for airgapped installs, and a Podman note. Tagging @raj for the unit, @sasha for SDK impact.

raj: I can paste a minimal drop-in. Recommend using a dedicated user `redwoodsvc`. Will also mention Slice and LimitNOFILE.

sasha: Add explicit manual steps for airgapped flows: `mkdir`, `chown`, `chmod`, and a `restorecon` example. Note: avoid telling users to disable SELinux; suggest `setenforce 0` only for transient debug.

ana: Draft snippets below, will put them under Private installer > Security > KMS.

ana: ```ini
# /etc/systemd/system/redwood-kms.socket.d/10-selinux.conf
[Socket]
ListenStream=/var/run/redwood/kms.sock
Service=redwood-kms.service
```

ana: ```bash
# airgap manual fix
sudo mkdir -p /var/run/redwood
sudo chown redwoodsvc:redwoodsvc /var/run/redwood/kms.sock
sudo chmod 0660 /var/run/redwood/kms.sock
# RHEL: semanage + restorecon (if available)
sudo semanage fcontext -a -t container_var_run_t '/var/run/redwood(/.*)?' || echo "install policycoreutils if missing"
sudo restorecon -R /var/run/redwood
```

secops-bot: Security guidance: restrict PKCS11 socket dir to group redwoodsvc, avoid symlinks, and include distro package fallback names in docs.

docs-bot: CI build started for branch ana/kms-selinux-note. Preview will be posted here when ready.

raj: LGTM for content. I'll add a one-line Podman tip pointing to our rootless note.

sasha: Reviewing now, will keep airgap section to 4 bullets and add a link to Installer preflight for user creation.

ana: Thanks, will merge after secops bot clears.
